name: scenario_0034
description: Eric is organizing his personal notes, reading lists, and shopping tasks by extracting information from various magazines and newspapers he is reading. He wants to ensure he doesn't create duplicate entries in his system.

amazon.products.name: The Ghosts of Cannae
amazon.products.description: A compelling history of the Battle of Cannae and its aftermath.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_2, image_4]
Query: Can you check if I have a note called 'Science News'? I want to avoid making duplicates. If I do, update it with the name of the company testing beta cells from the first image, and the name of the fired scientist from the second image. If not, just create a new note with those details.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check if you have a 'Science News' note and, if so, to update it with the company testing beta cells from the first image and the fired scientist from the second image (otherwise create it). The assistant will likely find multiple notes with similar names and ask you to clarify which one you mean. Tell it you want to update the 'Science News - General' note. Once the assistant confirms the note has been successfully updated with the extracted names, move on to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_5, image_6]
Query: Check my to-do list to see if I already have a task to read either of the Chinese books mentioned in this culture article. If I'm missing either, add it as a task. Also, check if I have a 'Tech Notes' file. If it exists, add the name of Apple's headset from this business article, otherwise create it.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to check your tasks to see if you already have a task to read either of the Chinese books mentioned in the culture article. If one is missing, it should add it. Also, ask it to check for a 'Tech Notes' note and update it with the name of Apple's headset from the business article (or create the note if it's missing). If the assistant mentions that a task for one of the books already exists, confirm that it should just add the missing one. Proceed once it confirms both the task creation and the note update.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_1, image_3]
Query: Take a look at my Amazon history and see if I've already bought the biography mentioned in this excerpt. If I haven't, set a reminder for tomorrow at 10 AM to buy it. Finally, check my tasks for anything about buying bedding; if there's nothing there, create a task to visit the store location on Yonge Street from this ad.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check your Amazon purchase history for the biography mentioned in the text excerpt. If it's not there, tell the assistant to set a reminder for tomorrow at 10 AM to buy it. Also, ask it to check your tasks to see if you have one for buying bedding. If not, it should create a task to visit the specific store location on Yonge Street shown in the ad. Once the assistant confirms the reminder is set and the task is created, you can end the conversation.
